1.content: Cell Types: S: start location; G: goal cell; H: hazardous cell; F: regular floor cell.

2.content: Moving onto a hazardous cell H will immediatly terminate the episode.

3.content: Moving onto the goal G will successfully end the episode.

4.content: Cell types remain static throughout an episode (they do not change when visited).

5.content: Agent actions (move_up, move_down, move_left, move_right) deterministically relocate the agent to the adjacent cell.

7.content: Reaching the goal cell G provides a positive reward of 1 point.

8.content: Entering the F, H, and S cells, yields zero immediate reward.

9.content: The agent can move beyond the grid and will be teleported to the other side.
